sharedRules.name: Holo Interference Field
sharedRules.description: At the end of this ship's activation, you may place a Holo Interference Field within 3" of this ship. These Holo Interference Fields are removed during the Cleanup step of the End Phase and are circular with a 4" diameter (a D6 or custom template are perfect tokens to represent these). Enemy Ships ignore the target's Spikes and Signature when attacking through a Holo Interference Field. Enemy Fighters & Bombers underneath the Holo Interference Field when it is placed, or that move/are placed into the Holo Interference Field are removed on a 4+.

sharedRules.name: Targeting Link
sharedRules.description: Friendly Ships within their Scan range of this Ship may use it as a spotter when they attack. If they do, before assigning weapons to targets, choose any amount of the attacking Ship's weapons. When assigning targets to those weapons, measure Weapons Range from this Ship, using this Ship's Scan. Attacks made this way must still be in Arc and line of sight of the attacking Ship. This rule has no effect on Close Action Weapons and weapons already benefiting from this rule.

sharedRules.name: Advanced ECM Suite
sharedRules.description: When a friendly Group (including this Ship's Group) within 4" of this Ship is attacked, you may have this Ship use its Advanced ECM Suite. If you do, after all weapons have been assigned, reduce the Lock of weapons belonging to one of the attacking Ships by 1 for the rest of the round. The attacking group must be on the same orbital layer as this ship. A Ship can be affected multiple times each round by this rule but each Ship with this rule can only use it once per round.

sharedRules.name: Catapult Launcher
sharedRules.description: When you launch Torpedoes from this Ship, if it launches a single Torpedo, you may launch that Torpedo up to 9" away instead of 6".

sharedRules.name: Feature Carrier
sharedRules.description: At the start of the game, before players deploy, choose one Deployable Feature from the PHR Deployable Features List. This Ship starts the game carrying that Deployable Feature.

sharedRules.name: Repair Nanomachines
sharedRules.description: Friendly Ships within 6" of this Ship that roll to repair Crippling Effects during the Repair step of the End Phase improve the results of those rolls by 2. Other friendly Ships that end their activation within 6" of this Ship on the same Orbital Layer recover 2 lost Hull Points.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: When you activate a Group of a single Ship, that Group must go on General Quarters this activation. That Group only removes a single Spike and does not turn before its movement. After its movement, the Group must turn between 45 and 90 degrees, then continue its activation as normal.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: At the start of a friendly Group's activation, remove one Crippling Effect token (of any type) from that Group.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: When you assign targets to Broadside Arc weapons, select one of those weapons with the Volley-X special rule. That weapon does not need to alternate arcs due to its Volley-X special rule (so can attack the same target in the same arc using each Volley attack) for that attack.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: When a friendly ship would roll for Crippling Damage, roll a dice. On a 4+ that Ship does not roll on the Crippling Damage table but is still Crippled.

rules.name: Cutting Power
rules.description: If you attack with and do not Overcharge any of this Flagship's Energy Glaive Batteries, they gain Reave-2 for their attacks this activation.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: When a friendly Group is given a Max Thrust order, it may turn as if it was on General Quarters.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: When you assign targets to weapons, select one of those weapons with the Calibre-X special rule. That weapon gains the benefits of its Calibre-X special rule regardless of the Tonnage of the target Group for that attack.

rules.name: Cull the Weak
rules.description: Heavy Quad Battery (Flak) may only be used to attack Ships of L Tonnage.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: When you assign targets to a weapon with the Calibre-H special rule, the attacking Ship doubles its Scan value against H Tonnage Ships for that weapon's attack (other attacks and weapons are unaffected).

rules.name: Self Repairing Armour Systems
rules.description: This Flagship cannot have its Energy Save reduced below a 5+.

rules.name: Heavy Calibre Orbital Gun
rules.description:
While a Ship is carrying this feature, it has the Heavy Calibre Orbital Gun (Mounted) Weapon System in addition to its normal Weapon Systems, using the carrying Ship's Scan with an Arc of FN.
This feature cannot use the Heavy Calibre Orbital Gun (Mounted) weapon profile.

rules.name: Shield Platform
rules.description:
Friendly Groups in coherency within 6" of this Dropsite gain the Reinforced Armour special rule.
This Dropsite counts as having the Reinforced Armour special rule against enemy attacks. Reduce the Lock of enemy weapons targeting this Dropsite by 1.

rules.name: Scanner Tower
rules.description: When you activate this Feature, place two Spikes on any enemy Group in line of sight, then, place another two Spikes on any enemy Group in line of sight.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: At the start of a friendly Group's activation, target an enemy Group that a friendly Admiral can draw line of sight to. Until the end of the activation, that Group cannot use its Backup Save, cannot gain the benefits of Aegis, and cannot gain the benefits of Fighters' Close Protection. If this Ability targets a H or C tonnage Group, this Ability costs 2AP.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Once per round, at the start of an enemy Group's activation, choose one of that Group's Weapon Systems. Until the end of that Group's activation, each of that Weapon System's attack dice results of a 1 causes the attacking Ship to lose the weapon's unmodified Damage value in hull points.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: When you assign targets to a Group's weapons, that Group's Broadside Arc weapons that have the Fusillade-X special rule gain the benefit of their Fusillade rule regardless of the Group's Order for its attacks this activation. If the attacking Group is on the Weapons Free order, it instead doubles the Fusillade value of those weapons for that attack.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Once per round, at the end of the Planning Phase, target an enemy Group that a friendly Admiral can draw line of sight to. At the start of that Group's activation, it must make a single Backup save. If it fails (or has no) Backup save, that Group cannot go on the Course Change and Max Thrust orders.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: At the end of the Repair step of the End Phase, target a friendly Ship. That Ship recovers D3 lost Hull Points.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: At the start of the Battalion Combat step of the Asset Phase, choose a Feature containing friendly Battalions. Until the end of the Battalion Combat step, those Battalions remove 2 enemy Battalions instead of 1 and may also be used to remove enemy Battalions from anywhere on that Dropsite in the 3rd step of the combat sequence.
